reason: The plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness skill provider that adds a predefined Karpathy-inspired coding-guidelines skill to the catalog with no runtime behavior of its own, and it requires an optional companion plugin for always-on injection; this is evidenced by the README and package metadata showing a single bundled, fixed-skill package and DSH patch-based wiring.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一个可选的 Karpathy 编码规范技能，可挂载后在技能目录中加载“karpathy-guidelines”内容，并可在需要时配合常驻注入插件使用。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an optional Karpathy-style coding-guidelines skill to DeepSeek Harness, making the packaged guideline content available in the skill catalog and optionally reusable with an always-apply consumer.

capabilities: Registers a bundled skill entry (`karpathy-guidelines`) for DeepSeek Harness.
Provides static guidance content from an `assets/` package resource for catalog/on-demand loading.
Supports optional always-apply behavior only when used with a separate consumer plugin.
